reuse.why: Changes the existing shared categoriesForMonthBudgetAction, which copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the three average actions already call, and reads the saved templates from goal_def as goal-template.ts stores them.

duplication.why: setZero's new query is a fourth copy of the categories-join-category_groups SQL the three average actions already repeat, and the `& { goal_def: string | null }` row type is repeated at three sites instead of added to DbViewCategoryWithGroupHidden.

placement.why: The which-categories rule stays in month-budget-categories.ts and the actions only supply rows.

scope.why: Limited to the selection rule, the queries feeding it, and a focused unit test.

maintainability.why: Dropping the per-action parameter makes the rule uniform and simple, but the repeated query/type and unformatted long lines leave cleanup for the next maintainer.

one_place.where: categoriesForMonthBudgetAction in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/month-budget-categories.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg
